# Binary test fixtures

Files that cannot be generated by the libraries Forge depends on.

## `locked-hunter2.pdf`

A 3-page PDF encrypted with AES-256. **User password: `hunter2`.**

It is checked in rather than generated because nothing in the dependency set
can *write* an encrypted PDF: `pdf-lib` has no encryption support, and PDFium
can open a locked document but exposes no save function. The alternative was a
hand-rolled RC4/Standard-Security-Handler writer in a test helper, which is a
lot of bespoke cryptography to maintain for one fixture.

It was produced by mupdf during a spike, before that dependency was removed for
being AGPL-3.0-or-later (see the phase 4a design doc, Amendment 1). A PDF
emitted by a tool is not a derivative work of that tool, so this file carries no
licence obligation — the same way a document is not encumbered by the editor
that wrote it.

Verified against PDFium: rejected with no password
(`Password required or incorrect password`), opens with `hunter2`, 3 pages.
